task.description:
Implement frontend requirements for Batch F2c on branch feature/WF02-f2c-batch2-20260529:

1. **PD-UI-07 — Export/Import**:
   - Add Export button on the definition editor page that downloads JSON via GET /definitions/{id}/export
   - Add Import button on the definition list page that accepts a JSON file and calls POST /definitions/import

2. **PD-UI-08 — Full-text search**:
   - Add debounced (300ms) search bar to definition list page
   - Query GET /definitions/search?q={query}
   - Show highlighted results

After implementation: cd web && npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run build
